name: VisuPro™
description: Designed for emerging presbyopes experiencing near-vision problems, offering a cost-effective transition to progressive lenses.
use_case: Ideal for regular or sporadic wearers aged 36-44 who are starting to face near-vision challenges.

name: MySV®
description: Personalized single vision lenses that go beyond one-size-fits-all, compensating prescriptions in all meridians.
features: Optimized base curve for larger frames
Individualized based on position of wear
use_case: For patients needing enhanced visual acuity and wider peripheral views than standard single vision lenses.

name: Sync III™
description: Engineered for single vision patients experiencing Digital Eye Strain (DES), with a 'boost zone' for near tasks.
features: Reduces eye strain from digital screens
Available in clear, photochromic, and polarized
use_case: Perfect for users who spend significant time on digital devices and suffer from eye strain.

name: iD Single Vision®
description: Bi-aspheric design for patients with high prescriptions, offering thinner lenses and an increased viewing area.
features: Integrated Dual Surface™ free form technology
Requires OC and monocular PD measurements
use_case: Best for those with high prescriptions who want optimized visual acuity and a relaxed, clear vision.

name: Single Vision iQ™
description: Brings PAL-level technology to single vision lenses with a custom back surfacing for enhanced optics.
features: Spherical front with custom back surface
Requires OC and monocular PD measurements
use_case: For wearers seeking the highest level of optical performance and clarity in a single vision lens.
